notes.subject: אשכחך/תשכח
notes.rationale: shakach repeated twice in one breath — 'forget you … forget' — the echo is the oath's engine and survives only as repeated 'toɔrɔ'.

notes.subject: right hand forget
notes.rationale: Hebrew verb has no object; KJV/JPS supply 'her cunning/skill', YLT supplies nothing — I supply only ⟨a⟩.

notes.subject: Yerushalayim
notes.rationale: Direct address to Jerusalem, not to God.

translation: Ni n ma i toɔrɔ, a Yerushalayim (Jerusalɛmu), i bolo cɛmma ka ⟨a⟩ toɔrɔ.
